meta.description: Unified logistics documentation master schema combining Stage-based milestone workflows (split by trade lane: IN_to_US and US_to_IN, filtered across D2D, D2P, P2D, P2P service scopes) and HS Chapter-specific regulatory compliance requirements (HS 01-99)[cite: 5, 7].

insurance.name: Marine Insurance Policy Certificate
insurance.description: Official insurance certificate listing cargo declared value & policy terms.

insurance.name: Cargo Valuation & Commercial Invoice Statement
insurance.description: Declared commercial invoice value statement for insurance claims coverage.

fumigation.name: ISPM-15 Fumigation Certificate
fumigation.description: Official plant quarantine ISPM-15 stamp compliance certificate.

hazmat.name: Dangerous Goods Declaration (DGD / IMO)
hazmat.description: Official IMO dangerous goods manifest and shipper declaration.

hazmat.name: Material Safety Data Sheet (MSDS)
hazmat.description: 16-section safety data sheet for chemical / battery transport.

reefer.name: Reefer Temperature Log Report
reefer.description: Automated IoT temperature recorder log file throughout transit.

reefer.name: Cold Chain Pre-Trip Inspection (PTI)
reefer.description: Pre-trip cooling check certificate for reefer container.

documents.name: Commercial Invoice
documents.description: Official invoice with cargo description, quantity, unit value, HS codes; issued to CHA, Buyer, and Bank.

documents.name: Packing List
documents.description: Itemized list of packages, piece count, net/gross weight, and dimensions; forwarded to CHA, Forwarder, and CFS.

documents.name: Delivery Challan / E-way Bill
documents.description: Domestic transport document authorizing movement of goods from factory to CFS/ICD gate entry.

IN_to_US.stage_name: Booking, CHA / Customs Filing & Origin Terminal

documents.name: Booking Confirmation
documents.description: Confirmed vessel/flight space allocation with booking reference and cut-off dates.

documents.name: Shipping Instructions (SI)
documents.description: Instructions to Shipping Line specifying B/L consignee, notify party, cargo marks, and description.

documents.name: Shipping Bill
documents.description: Official export declaration filed with Indian Customs via ICEGATE to obtain statutory export clearance.

documents.name: Certificate of Origin
documents.description: Certifies country of manufacture; issued to US Buyer for preferential duty claims and import compliance.

documents.name: VGM Declaration
documents.description: SOLAS-mandatory declared container gross weight submitted to Shipping Line / Terminal before loading.

documents.name: COA (as applicable)
documents.description: Certificate of Analysis for quality-controlled goods attached to Indian Customs filing.

documents.name: Examination Report
documents.description: Official customs physical/scanning examination report confirming cargo matches Shipping Bill declaration.

documents.name: LEO (Let Export Order)
documents.description: Final permission from Indian Customs allowing cargo to be loaded onto vessel.

documents.name: Gate Pass / EIR
documents.description: Terminal gate entry/exit authorization and container condition receipt.

documents.name: Mate's Receipt
documents.description: Acknowledgment from the ship's mate that cargo was loaded on board in apparent good order.

documents.name: Draft Bill of Lading
documents.description: Draft B/L forwarded to Exporter for review and approval before final release.

documents.name: Final B/L (Original / Telex)
documents.description: Final issued Bill of Lading (3 originals or telex release); primary title document.

documents.name: ISF / 10+2 (Importer Security Filing)
documents.recipient: US CBP (filed 24 hrs BEFORE vessel loads at Indian port)
documents.description: US CBP mandatory security filing submitted electronically at least 24 hours prior to container lading.

documents.name: Carrier's Manifest
documents.description: Complete manifest of all cargo on board transmitted by Shipping Line to US CBP.

documents.name: Arrival Notice
documents.description: Notification sent to US Consignee detailing freight charges, free time, and demurrage schedules.

documents.name: Original B/L Surrender / Telex Release
documents.recipient: Shipping Line (issues Delivery Order in return)
documents.description: US Importer surrenders original B/L (or telex release confirmation) to carrier in exchange for D.O.

documents.name: Delivery Order (D.O.)
documents.description: Commercial release document authorizing marine terminal to release container for pickup.

documents.name: CBP Entry (Form 3461 & 7501)
documents.description: US CBP import entry — Form 3461 (Entry/Immediate Delivery) and Form 7501 (Entry Summary) — filed via ACE.

documents.name: Certificate of Origin (for trade preference)
documents.description: Presented to US CBP to claim preferential tariff duty rates under trade agreements.

documents.name: Import Permit (FDA / USDA / EPA)
documents.description: Partner Government Agency (PGA) clearance for controlled goods (food, pharma, plants, chemicals).

documents.name: Customs Bond
documents.description: Continuous or single-entry bond guaranteeing duties, taxes, and penalties owed to US CBP.

documents.name: HTS Classification & Duty Calculation
documents.description: Correct HTS code determination and duty rate calculation submitted to US CBP.

documents.name: Duty / Tax Payment
documents.description: Settlement of assessed import duties, Harbor Maintenance Fee (HMF), and Merchandise Processing Fee (MPF).

documents.name: CBP Exam Report (X-ray / VACIS / Physical)
documents.description: Official US CBP inspection report (VACIS scan or physical tailgate examination).

documents.name: Entry Release ('Cargo Released')
documents.description: US CBP 1C electronic cargo release notification confirming customs clearance.

documents.name: Terminal Release / Pickup Number
documents.description: Terminal-issued pickup authorization allowing motor carrier to collect container.

documents.name: Container Interchange Report
documents.description: Documents container physical condition at out-gate pickup to protect against liability.

documents.name: Delivery Receipt / Inland B/L
documents.description: Inland transport document covering last-mile movement from US port/terminal to consignee door.

documents.name: Proof of Delivery (POD)
documents.description: Delivery receipt countersigned by US Importer acknowledging goods received in good condition.

documents.name: Empty Container Return Receipt
documents.description: Receipt issued by container depot confirming empty container returned in accepted condition.

documents.name: Commercial Invoice
documents.description: Official commercial invoice detailing goods, value, HTS code, and terms of sale.

documents.name: Packing List
documents.description: Detailed packing breakdown showing package count, gross/net weight, and dimensions.

documents.name: Delivery Order / Transport Note
documents.description: Inland bill of lading / transport document authorizing pickup and transfer to US terminal.

US_to_IN.stage_name: Booking, Customs Broker Filing & US Origin Port

documents.name: Booking Confirmation
documents.description: Confirmed booking space reservation with carrier for vessel/flight departure.

documents.name: Shipping Instructions (SI)
documents.description: Instructions to ocean carrier declaring shipper, consignee, notify party, and cargo details.

documents.name: AES Filing / ITN / EEI
documents.recipient: US CBP (before vessel departs US port)
documents.description: Electronic Export Information (EEI) filed via AES obtaining an Internal Transaction Number (ITN).

documents.name: Export License (if ECCN / dual-use)
documents.description: Validated BIS / DDTC license for controlled dual-use or munitions list commodities.

documents.name: Certificate of Origin
documents.description: Certifies manufacture in the US; dispatched to India Importer for customs processing.

documents.name: VGM Declaration
documents.description: SOLAS Verified Gross Mass declaration certified and submitted before terminal loading.

documents.name: CBP Examination Report
documents.description: Report generated in the event of an outbound customs outbound outbound hold or inspection.

documents.name: Export Clearance (AES / ITN Validation)
documents.description: Customs validation granting terminal permission to lade container on board vessel.

documents.name: Mate's Receipt
documents.description: Acknowledgment that goods were loaded on board in apparent good condition.

documents.name: Draft Bill of Lading
documents.description: Draft B/L circulated for shipper review and verification before final issuance.

documents.name: Final B/L (Original / Telex)
documents.description: Final ocean bill of lading establishing title; forwarded to India consignee/bank.

US_to_IN.stage_name: Main Freight International Transit (US to India)

documents.name: IGM (Import General Manifest)
documents.description: Statutory manifest filed by carrier with Indian Customs prior to vessel arrival.

documents.name: Arrival Notice
documents.description: Notice sent to Indian consignee detailing vessel arrival, container destination CFS, and charges.

documents.name: Original B/L Surrender / Telex Release
documents.recipient: Shipping Line (issues Delivery Order in return)
documents.description: Surrender of original B/L or telex release confirmation to line to obtain Delivery Order.

documents.name: Delivery Order (D.O.)
documents.description: Carrier authorization issued to CHA allowing customs clearance and cargo movement from port.

documents.name: Bill of Entry
documents.description: Legal import declaration filed on ICEGATE for home consumption or warehousing.

documents.name: Certificate of Origin (for FTA benefit)
documents.description: Certificate presented to claim concessional customs duty under applicable trade treaties.

documents.name: Import License / BIS / FSSAI / Phytosanitary (as applicable)
documents.description: Statutory regulatory permits (FSSAI NOC, BIS ISI certificate, Plant Quarantine Permit).

documents.name: Duty Calculation / Assessment
documents.description: Customs assessment of basic customs duty, IGST, and social welfare surcharge.

documents.name: Duty Payment Challan
documents.description: Electronic challan acknowledging payment of customs duties via ICEGATE.

documents.name: Examination Report
documents.description: Customs dock inspection/appraisal report verifying container seals and content.

documents.name: Out of Charge (OOC) Order
documents.description: Final customs clearance order authorizing cargo delivery from customs custody.

documents.name: Terminal Gate Pass / Release Note
documents.description: CFS gate pass issued to trucker allowing container out-gate movement.

documents.name: Delivery Challan
documents.description: Transport dispatch document accompanying vehicle during final delivery.

documents.name: Proof of Delivery (POD)
documents.description: Receipt signed and stamped by importer confirming physical delivery of goods.

documents.name: Empty Container Return Receipt
documents.description: Equipment receipt issued upon returning de-stuffed empty container to the shipping line depot.

chapters.export_note: Chapter 99 is an import-side tariff mechanism used to apply trade remedies, Section 301/232 exclusions, and temporary concessions[cite: 5, 7, 9].
